summary_ja: トレーディング・デスク間の内部取引をマーケット・リスク相当額の計測範囲に含め、内部取引担当デスクと他のデスク間の内部取引については前条の要件を満たす場合にのみ計測対象に含める旨を規定する条文。
summary_en: Includes inter-trading-desk internal transactions in the scope of market risk equivalent measurement, and includes internal transactions between the internal transactions desk and other desks only when the conditions of the preceding Article are satisfied.
